Welcome to DATA 622, Machine Learning and Big Data.

Click this post now to get started!

Here are the first steps:

* Read the [syllabus](../course/syllabus.qmd).
* Go through the course overview materials, and complete the [week 1 readings](../modules/module1.qmd).
* [Make sure you have a good python environment and IDE setup](../course/software.qmd)
* Introduce yourself on the course discussion forum on Brightspace.
* [Join our Slack workspace:](https://join.slack.com/t/cuny-msds/shared_invite/zt-3ans1b3dz-5HhIols06wNraCMUhZ~jXw)
  - I will invite you to a DATA 622 Slack Channel within that workspace when you join
* Attend our first meetup on Monday at 6:45 p.m. ET on [Zoom](https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81858708616?pwd=eE9ZGJFco9iicq3BsmANIfWUVLwy0x.1)
